description: This PHP source file provides server-side logic for an AJAX-driven tree structure in the TestLink project, handling retrieval and display of requirement nodes and their hierarchy. It includes functions to generate JSON data representing nested requirement elements based on database queries, supporting client-side navigation and management.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class used to manage and interact with the hierarchical structure of nodes within the database context.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Generates a list of child nodes for a given parent in the requirement hierarchy, returning data suitable for client-side rendering.
